_note: CPI-U relative importance (% of All items), U.S. city average, copied from the 'Relative importance' column of BLS CPI news release Table 2 (https://www.bls.gov/news.release/cpi.t02.htm). That column is the previous month's relative importance, which is the correct weight for the current month's change. Update as_of + weights after each CPI release. SASL2RS (supercore) is not listed in Table 2: it is derived as (Services less energy services + Energy services) - Rent of shelter.
